# Catalysts of the pilot pack: the dated public events (generated by wip/platform-phase6b/build_pack_tables.py)

The first-utterance test (core) compares the earliest held telling of a claim with this dated list. The threshold catalyst is the Computer Weekly story of 11 May 2009, the first press telling held: a telling held before it is `pre-2009 held`. Events marked "not public at the time" are listed for the timeline, not as catalysts.

|---|---|---|---|

| 2009-05-11 | Computer Weekly publishes Rebecca Thomson's investigation: the threshold catalyst (the first press telling held) | public | Computer Weekly, 11 May 2009, `sources/pilot/web/2009-05-11-bankruptcy-prosecution-and-disrupted-livelihoods-postmasters-tell/text.md`:298 |
| 2009 | two MPs report constituents' concerns to the minister, who forwards them to POL | not public at the time | Hamilton [2021] EWCA Crim 577, `sources/pilot/canon/hamilton-v-post-office/paragraphs.txt`:251 (at [23]) |
| 2010 | Horizon Online (HNG-X) replaces Legacy Horizon | public | Hamilton [2021] EWCA Crim 577, `sources/pilot/canon/hamilton-v-post-office/paragraphs.txt`:144 (at [10]) |
